ToD_A03_M09_VO_S001_001.source_old: Greetings Sir! I am glad that the Magocracy of Dalaran has sent reinforcements to Tyr's Hand.
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S001_001.source_new: Greetings Sir! I am glad that the Magocracy of Dalaran has sent reinforcements to Tyr's Hand.

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S001_002.source_old: Greetings Captain. I have information that the Horde is gathering naval forces in the region and may try to cut our supply lines to Quel'thalas. This must not happen.
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S001_002.source_new: Greetings Captain. I have information that the Horde is gathering naval forces in the region and may try to cut our supply lines to Quel'thalas. This must not happen.

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S001_003.source_old: Indeed. We have already sent a squadron of our best men to destroy the orcish camp.
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S001_003.source_new: Indeed. We have already sent a squadron of our best men to destroy the orcish camp.

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S001_004.source_old: Good. I will remain in the tower and provide arcane support for your troops if needed.
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S001_004.source_new: Good. I will remain in the tower and provide arcane support for your troops if needed.

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S002_001.source_old: Good day, sir. We have started to gather the winter crops from the local populace as requested. They are being loaded onto the ships as we speak.
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S002_001.source_new: Good day, sir. We have started to gather the winter crops from the local populace as requested. They are being loaded onto the ships as we speak.

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S002_002.source_old: Good. Make sure that all of the ships are loaded with grain and supplies at maximum capacity.
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S002_002.source_new: Good. Make sure that all of the ships are loaded with grain and supplies at maximum capacity.

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S002_003.source_old: Sir, if I may speak freely... I have concerns about this order. We are taking the very last grain that the peasants have. If we follow through with this, then they will be starving in a matter of months.
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S002_003.source_new: Sir, if I may speak freely... I have concerns about this order. We are taking the very last grain that the peasants have. If we follow through with this, then they will be starving in a matter of months.

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S002_004.source_old: I know, but when Stromgarde fell we also lost most of our fleet. Without these supplies, we will be unable to enlist archers and destroyers from our elven allies. We will be defenseless
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S002_004.source_new: I know, but when Stromgarde fell we also lost most of our fleet. Without these supplies, we will be unable to enlist archers and destroyers from our elven allies. We will be defenseless.

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S002_006.source_old: We will provide for them later. Now, focus on setting up the caravans.
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S002_006.source_new: We will provide for them later. Now, focus on setting up the caravans.

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S003_001.source_old: Finally, we have arrived. I believe the Blacktooth Grin camp is on the other side of the island.
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S003_001.source_new: Finally, we have arrived. I believe the Blacktooth Grin camp is on the other side of the island.

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S003_002.source_old: Our scouts report that Tyr's Bay is filled with Alliance troops, both ground and naval. It is fortunate that we managed to make landfall without being noticed.
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S003_002.source_new: Our scouts report that Tyr's Bay is filled with Alliance troops, both ground and naval. It is fortunate that we managed to make landfall without being noticed.

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S003_003.source_old: It is indeed, which is why we must make haste. I have lost faith in my feeble-minded brother’s ability to command our forces here. He barely avoided punishment after his failure at Dun Modr.
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S003_003.source_new: It is indeed, which is why we must make haste. I have lost faith in my feeble-minded brother’s ability to command our forces here. He barely avoided punishment after his failure at Dun Modr.

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S004_001.source_old: Chieftain, this gorge is a perfect place for an ambush.
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S004_001.source_new: Chieftain, this gorge is a perfect place for an ambush.

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S004_006.source_old: Hello mon. Zul'jin be sending his greetings. He told us ya might be needing some help here.
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S004_006.source_new: Hello mon. Zul'jin be sending his greetings. He told us ya might be needing some help here.

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S004_007.source_old: Your arrival saved our lives, mighty Amani. Truly, your worth to the Horde and fighting skills are beyond question. How did you gain such a strength and ferocity?
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S004_007.source_new: Your arrival saved our lives, mighty Amani. Truly, your worth to the Horde and fighting skills are beyond question. How did you gain such a strength and ferocity?

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S004_008.source_old: I went through a sacred ritual of initiation. If you can find a bloodvine plant and give it to the goblin alchemist - our witch doctor can share his ingredients to brew a potion that will transform all of our axe throwers into berserkers.
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S004_008.source_new: I went through a sacred ritual of initiation. If you can find a bloodvine plant and give it to the goblin alchemist - our witch doctor can share his ingredients to brew a potion that will transform all of our axe throwers into berserkers.

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S004_009.source_old: Then we need to find that plant Immediately. Thank you, mighty berserker.
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S004_009.source_new: Then we need to find that plant immediately. Thank you, mighty berserker.

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S007_001.source_old: Aaah the Alliance scum has sent us more sheep to carve up, slaughter them boys.
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S007_001.source_new: Aaah the Alliance scum has sent us more sheep to carve up, slaughter them boys.

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S008_001.source_old: Oh brother... everytime you’re tasked with a mission of your own you always almost ruin it!
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S008_001.source_new: Oh brother... everytime you’re tasked with a mission of your own you always almost ruin it!

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S008_002.source_old: I could have solved that problem on my own, Rend! Stop blaming me!
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S008_002.source_new: I could have solved that problem on my own, Rend! Stop blaming me!

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S008_003.source_old: The Warchief is watching our every move you blundering idiot... your constant rashness is putting us both at risk!
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S008_003.source_new: The Warchief is watching our every move you blundering idiot... your constant rashness is putting us both at risk!

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S008_004.source_old: Hey you there! Gather these two peons and make sure that they repair all the buildings.
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S008_004.source_new: Hey you there! Gather these two peons and make sure that they repair all the buildings.

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S008_006.source_old: And what are you looking at? We need a working oil rig! Enough slacking!
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S008_006.source_new: And what are you looking at? We need a working oil rig! Enough slacking!

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S008_007.source_old: Hmmm... it seems like humans are going to send ships with supplies to quel'thalas. We should put an end to that.
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S008_007.source_new: Hmmm... it seems like humans are going to send ships with supplies to Quel'Thalas. We should put an end to that.

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S009_001.source_old: Scratcher... the Stormreaver clan has sent an Ogre Magi to reinforce the Blacktooth Grin camp. Have you seen him?
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S009_001.source_new: Scratcher... the Stormreaver clan has sent an Ogre Magi to reinforce the Blacktooth Grin camp. Have you seen him?

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S009_002.source_old: No, he must have been on the other ship.
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S009_002.source_new: No, he must have been on the other ship.

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S009_003.source_old: Then secure the island and find that beast! We need his arcane support here.
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S009_003.source_new: Then secure the island and find that beast! We need his arcane support here.

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S010_001.source_old: By the light! The orcs have destroyed the shipyards!
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S010_001.source_new: By the Light! The orcs have destroyed the shipyards!

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S010_002.source_old: Those filthy creatures will pay for their arrogance! Gather your men, we're going on the offensive!
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S010_002.source_new: Those filthy creatures will pay for their arrogance! Gather your men, we're going on the offensive!

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S010_003.source_old: But my Lord... how will we cross the bay?
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S010_003.source_new: But my Lord... how will we cross the bay?

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S010_004.source_old: You won't need your ships, Captain. I will freeze both the bay and the very blood of these savages!
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S010_004.source_new: You won't need your ships, Captain. I will freeze both the bay and the very blood of these savages!

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S011_001.source_old: Chieftains! Some sort of magic has frozen our fleet! The bay is solid ice!
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S011_001.source_new: Chieftains! Some sort of magic has frozen our fleet! The bay is solid ice!

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S011_002.source_old: To hell with the ships! We will march on the keep on foot... straight across the ice!
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S011_002.source_new: To hell with the ships! We will march on the keep on foot... straight across the ice!

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S011_003.source_old: Let us crush the humans and their pathetic allies!
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S011_003.source_new: Let us crush the humans and their pathetic allies!

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S012_001.source_old: Your Holiness, the Horde has captured the Stromgarde keep in the bay!
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S012_001.source_new: Your Holiness, the Horde has captured the Stromgarde keep in the bay!

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S012_002.source_old: We must inform lord Valdelmar at once!
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S012_002.source_new: We must inform Lord Valdemar at once!

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S012_004.source_old: Lord Valdemar, I…I tried my best to hold the bay, but those unholy savages were ruthless.
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S012_004.source_new: Lord Valdemar, I…I tried my best to hold the bay, but those unholy savages were ruthless.

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S012_005.source_old: You’ve fought bravely, my lord Saidan, I will take my men and hold the line for as long as it’s needed.
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S012_005.source_new: You’ve fought bravely, my lord Saidan, I will take my men and hold the line for as long as it’s needed.

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S012_006.source_old: I’m with you… I will not hide here while men die for me!
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S012_006.source_new: I’m with you… I will not hide here while men die for me!

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S012_007.source_old: No Sir Saidan! You are far too important to be in the vanguard… you’re wounded and too weak to fight. Live to fight another day…
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S012_007.source_new: No Sir Saidan! You are far too important to be in the vanguard… you’re wounded and far too weak to fight. Live to fight another day…

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S012_009.source_old: Once you have gathered your strength, travel ahead and inform lord Uther of what has transpired here. The Alliance needs to send reinforcements!
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S012_009.source_new: Once you have gathered your strength, travel ahead and inform lord Uther of what has transpired here. The Alliance needs to send reinforcements!

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S012_010.source_old: Fight with the light’s blessing, lord Valdemar, and give those beasts the justice they deserve!
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S012_010.source_new: Fight with the light’s blessing, lord Valdemar, and give those beasts the justice they deserve!

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S013_001.source_old: Hold the line you maggots! We captured this keep and will not be losing it to these humans!
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S013_001.source_new: Hold the line you maggots! We captured this keep and will not be losing it to these humans!

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S013_003.source_old: They will regret ever setting foot on this island!
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S013_003.source_new: They will regret ever setting foot on this island!

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S014_001.source_old: I will inform the Warchief of our victory against the Stromgarde remnants here. It is best that you stay here and await his orders... and try not to fight with each other. You are both valuable to the Horde and our Warchief.
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S014_001.source_new: I will inform the Warchief of our victory against the Stromgarde remnants here. It is best that you stay here and await his orders... and try not to fight with each other. You are both valuable to the Horde and our Warchief.

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S014_002.source_old: That shaman has become too arrogant, brother.
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S014_002.source_new: That shaman has become too arrogant, brother.

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S014_003.source_old: Utok has built quite the reputation for himself in this war... he may be completely loyal to Doomhammer, but I don’t doubt his service to the Horde for a second. He’s a brave warrior, despite our differences.
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S014_003.source_new: Utok has built quite the reputation for himself in this war... he may be completely loyal to Doomhammer, but I don’t doubt his service to the Horde for a second. He’s a brave warrior, despite our differences.

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S014_004.source_old: That may be, but Rend… thank you for aiding me in this battle. Sometimes I can’t stand you, but fighting alongside you fills my heart with passion.
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S014_004.source_new: That may be, but Rend… thank you for aiding me in this battle. Sometimes I can’t stand you, but fighting alongside you fills my heart with passion.

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S014_005.source_old: Likewise Maim. You and I share the blood and heritage of our father. One day, we will rule the horde and neither Doomhammer nor any of his pets will stand in our way. Now, let’s have our well earned feast!
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S014_005.source_new: Likewise Maim. You and I share the blood and heritage of our father. One day, we will rule the horde and neither Doomhammer nor any of his pets will stand in our way. Now, let’s have our well earned feast!

ToD_A03_M09_VO_S014_006.source_old: Yeah, a feast is what we need after a good battle!
ToD_A03_M09_VO_S014_006.source_new: Yeah, a feast is what we need after a good battle!
